articles.summary: New subsidiary plans to focus on small and mid-sized U.S. AI data centers, using modular construction and multiple power sources NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced the formation of Chaince Compute Inc. (“Chaince Compute”), a wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated in Delaware on November 2, 2026. Chaince Compute intends to pursue the development of artificial intelligence (“AI”) data center projects in the United States. As demand for AI computing grows, sites with available power capacity have become a key constraint on new data center development. Chaince Compute’s planned approach has three elements: Small and mid-sized U.S. projects – a focus on developing AI data center projects in the United States with target power capacity of up to 100 megawatts (“MW”) each; Integrated, modular construction – an integrated, modular build model intended to shorten construction timelines, with a target construction period of under 12 months per project; and Multiple power sources – combining grid power with other power sources, such as solar and energy storage, with the aim of addressing limited grid […]

articles.summary: Underwriting and brokerage drove growth across a diversified financial services platform and the Company reported net income for the quarter. The Company held approximately $60.0 million in cash, short-term investments and stablecoins at quarter-end NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue growth for the first nine months of 2026 was driven by underwriter services, industry advisory and consulting, and transaction execution and brokerage, reflecting an expansion in both the number of engagements and the diversity of services provided compared with 2025. Nine-month revenue of $2.78 million has already exceeded the Company’s full-year 2025 revenue of $1.87 million by approximately 49%. Alongside this growth, the Company strengthened its capital position and simplified its capital structure by repurchasing and canceling all of the outstanding warrants issued in its November 2023 private placement.
